Description.Name: CDB
Description.Details:
Connie Dorr grew up working in adoptive father Fibbs junkyard on the Canopian border world of Zathras, taking an interest in tinkering with the occasional broken down industrial and agro mechs that came in.  Following his passing and seeing no reason to stay she became a stowaway on an SLDF cargo vessel leaving Zathras at the onset of the Amaris Uprising.  Quickly found and arrested, she eventually earned enough trust to be allowed to help in the mech bays and in time became an official MechTech.  As the war waged on and the ranks of MechWarriors declined she was selected to become one herself, seeing combat in the final year of the civil war.

After the war she would follow General Kerensky on his exodus. Following the forming of the clans she was sorted into the warrior caste of Clan Snow Raven.  After the migration of a periphery nation near the Kerensky Cluster she was chosen to lead a team to follow them back to the inner sphere, posing as the mercenary company AGASGV KOGA on a mission to gather information and lay the groundwork for the clans arrival. She became embedded among the embattled Outworlds Alliance to aid in their, aiding in the reconquering of core territories.  AGASGV KOGA, retained by Outworlds Alliance, would go on to assist in numerous conflicts and eventually be integrated as an official regiment.

Having become a trusted advisor of President Avellar, Connie continued working to influence Outworlds Alliance to be receptive to a planned merger upon Clan Snow Ravens arrival.
